<string name="map_layer_signal_coverage_description">Highlights where your cell signal was weak or missing. The redder the area, the worse the coverage; well-covered areas stay clear.</string>
<string name="map_layer_speed_heatmap_description">Heatmap representing the speed of movement across different areas.</string>

<string name="map_layer_legacy_heatmap_description">Throwback to the original Signals app: your location density drawn as discrete 25\u202fm grid tiles, the way the heatmap looked when tiles were rendered on the server. Zoom in to see the squares.</string>

<string name="map_layer_seasonal_description">A patchwork of seasonal memory: every area you\u2019ve explored is tinted by the season you first visited it in. Find the trails you only ever walk in summer, or the streets you only see in winter.</string>

<string name="map_layer_terrain_description">Your location density lifted into 3D: the places you spend the most time rise as tall glowing mesas, while one-off spots stay low. Tilt the map to see the relief of your life.</string>

<string name="map_layer_speed_ribbon_description">Your route painted by how fast you were moving, flowing colour from a slow violet amble to a red-hot sprint or drive. Unlike the speed heatmap, the ribbon keeps your path intact so you can see exactly where you sped up and slowed down.</string>

<string name="map_layer_fog_description">The world emerging from the fog: every area you\u2019ve touched is revealed, glowing brighter the more thoroughly you got to know it. Places you merely passed through stay a faint haze; somewhere you explored deeply burns solid gold. Unexplored ground stays dark.</string>

<string name="map_layer_first_contact_description">A timeline of your discoveries: each area is coloured by how recently you first set foot there. The places you found long ago fade to deep indigo, while ground you broke this week glows bright cyan\u2014read the story of your exploration outward to your newest frontiers.</string>
<string name="map_layer_location_polyline_description">Line connecting your recorded locations over time.</string>

<string name="map_layer_wifi_count_heatmap_description">Shows how many distinct access points overlap at each place. Repeated scans of the same AP count once, so hotter areas mean genuinely denser radio coverage.</string>
